description: Structured eval definitions for the Timestream Database Deployer. Five-case proven set exercising the READY_TO_DEPLOY / PREREQUISITES_MISSING classification across Timestream topologies (database+table with retention and scheduled query, magnetic store write properties with S3 integration, partition key enforcement for high-cardinality tables, batch load task for historical ingestion, missing S3 bucket policy for magnetic store writes). Each eval maps to a prompt file and a baseline (no-skill) file for with-skill-vs-baseline comparison.

eval_cases.name: Timestream database with table, retention properties, and scheduled query
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — database creation, table with memory/magnetic TTL, scheduled query with target table and SNS notification
eval_cases.prompt: Create a Timestream database named IoTSensorData in us-east-1. Create a table TemperatureReadings with memory store TTL of 12 hours and magnetic store TTL of 365 days. Create a scheduled query named HourlyTemperatureAggregation that aggregates temperature readings hourly into a target table HourlyTempAggregates. SNS topic for errors: arn:aws:sns:us-east-1:123456789012:timestream-errors. Execution role: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/TimestreamSQRole. Tags: Environment=production, Team=iot.
eval_cases.expected_output:
TIMESTREAM: IoTSensorData / TemperatureReadings
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Database: IoTSensorData (region us-east-1)
  [✓] Table: TemperatureReadings
  [✓] Memory store TTL: 12h
  [✓] Magnetic store TTL: 365d
  [✓] Scheduled query: HourlyTemperatureAggregation
  [✓] Scheduled query notification: SNS arn:aws:sns:us-east-1:123456789012:timestream-errors
  [✓] Scheduled query execution role: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/TimestreamSQRole
  [✓] Tags: Environment=production, Team=iot
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws timestream-write describe-database --database-name IoTSensorData --region us-east-1
  aws timestream-write describe-table --database-name IoTSensorData --table-name TemperatureReadings --region us-east-1

eval_cases.name: Timestream table with magnetic store write properties and S3 integration
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — magnetic store write properties enabled, S3 bucket with bucket policy for late-arrival data
eval_cases.prompt: Create a Timestream database named IoTSensorData and table EventLogs in us-east-1. Memory store TTL 6 hours, magnetic store TTL 730 days. Enable magnetic store writes with S3 bucket timestream-late-arrival-us-east-1 for late-arrival data. The bucket already has a policy granting Timestream s3:PutObject. Tags: Environment=production.
eval_cases.expected_output:
TIMESTREAM: IoTSensorData / EventLogs
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Database: IoTSensorData (region us-east-1)
  [✓] Table: EventLogs
  [✓] Memory store TTL: 6h
  [✓] Magnetic store TTL: 730d
  [✓] Magnetic store writes: Enabled (S3: timestream-late-arrival-us-east-1)
  [✓] Tags: Environment=production
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws timestream-write describe-table --database-name IoTSensorData --table-name EventLogs --region us-east-1

eval_cases.name: Timestream table with partition key enforcement for high-cardinality queries
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — partition key enforcement REQUIRED for query performance on high-cardinality dimension-filtered workload
eval_cases.prompt: Create a Timestream database named MetricsDB and table HighCardinalityMetrics in us-east-1. Memory store TTL 1 hour, magnetic store TTL 90 days. Enable partition key enforcement with EnforcementInRecord=REQUIRED. Queries frequently filter by device_id and region. Tags: Environment=production, Workload=high-cardinality.
eval_cases.expected_output:
TIMESTREAM: MetricsDB / HighCardinalityMetrics
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Database: MetricsDB (region us-east-1)
  [✓] Table: HighCardinalityMetrics
  [✓] Memory store TTL: 1h
  [✓] Magnetic store TTL: 90d
  [✓] Partition key enforcement: REQUIRED
  [✓] Tags: Environment=production, Workload=high-cardinality
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws timestream-write describe-table --database-name MetricsDB --table-name HighCardinalityMetrics --region us-east-1

eval_cases.name: Timestream batch load task for historical S3 data ingestion
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — batch load task created with CSV data source S3 bucket and report configuration
eval_cases.prompt: Create a Timestream database named HistoricalData and table SensorArchive in us-east-1 with memory store TTL 1 hour and magnetic store TTL 3650 days. Create a batch load task to ingest CSV data from S3 bucket historical-sensor-data (prefix 2024/) into the table. Report bucket: batch-load-reports. Tags: Environment=production, Purpose=historical-backfill.
eval_cases.expected_output:
TIMESTREAM: HistoricalData / SensorArchive
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Database: HistoricalData (region us-east-1)
  [✓] Table: SensorArchive
  [✓] Memory store TTL: 1h
  [✓] Magnetic store TTL: 3650d
  [✓] Batch load task: configured (data source: historical-sensor-data/2024/, report: batch-load-reports)
  [✓] Tags: Environment=production, Purpose=historical-backfill
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws timestream-write describe-table --database-name HistoricalData --table-name SensorArchive --region us-east-1

eval_cases.name: Timestream magnetic store writes without S3 bucket policy (prerequisite failure)
eval_cases.branch: PREREQUISITES_MISSING — S3 bucket lacks bucket policy granting Timestream s3:PutObject; magnetic store writes will silently fail
eval_cases.prompt: Create a Timestream table LateArrivalData with magnetic store writes enabled using S3 bucket my-data-bucket. The bucket does NOT have a bucket policy granting Timestream s3:PutObject. Database name IoTSensorData, region us-east-1. Memory store TTL 6h, magnetic store TTL 365d.
eval_cases.expected_output:
TIMESTREAM: IoTSensorData / LateArrivalData
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✗] Magnetic store writes: bucket my-data-bucket missing required bucket policy granting Timestream s3:PutObject
